content:
Let \(f(n)\) be the number of valid queues for \(n\) girls.

In any valid queue, the tallest girl must be at one of the two ends; otherwise she stands between two shorter girls. After placing her at an end, the remaining \(n-1\) girls must also form a valid queue. Thus

\[
f(n)=2f(n-1),\quad f(1)=1.
\]

So

\[
f(10)=2^9=512.
\]

\[
\boxed{512}
\]
